startup.command: docker build -t sectester-js-demo-ci . && docker run --rm -d --name sectester-js-demo-ci -p 3000:3000 sectester-js-demo-ci
startup.context: Attempt 1 failed because the existing Dockerfile required a root .env file that was missing from the checkout. I added .env using the existing BRIGHT_HOSTNAME and BRIGHT_TOKEN values from the host environment, and patched Nest bootstrap to listen on 0.0.0.0 via app.listen(..., '0.0.0.0'). Rebuilt and started successfully; curl to http://127.0.0.1:3000/api-json returned HTTP 200 with the Swagger/OpenAPI document.

scanPrep.context:

Change: Rebuilt and relaunched the single app container with the verified docker build/run command so the source change is active.
Change: Queried the running container and app runtime: environment and SQLite schema show no DB-backed rate-limit/CAPTCHA settings tables, package/runtime inspection shows no NestJS throttler/rate-limit/session/CAPTCHA modules, and OpenAPI/source inspection shows no login/auth endpoints or server-side CAPTCHA enforcement.
